split.independence: Views are correlated observations of one stack/disassembly sequence. Held-out group D is reserved from implementation tuning; this is not independent-stack generalization.

primary_visual_face_reference.meaning: Complete manually identified visible 2x4 top-facing regions, not calibrated current-top height, hidden occupancy, mechanical access or robot-frame poses.

supplemental_missing_track.meaning: A complete same-orientation face is visibly missing at an expected slot in a supplied image-plane layout hypothesis. This does not prove absence of a hidden/occluded physical brick.

lower_surface_track.meaning: Selected non-exhaustive visible lower-layer fragments. A zero error count cannot prove global layer discrimination, especially when candidates avoid gaps by construction. Actual top-layer height accuracy is not measurable from the supplied uncalibrated JPEGs.

matching.instance: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one IoU >= 0.50 on axis-aligned envelopes of reference/predicted quadrilaterals, then maximize IoU. Merged candidates are ineligible as individual true positives.
matching.merged: Candidate contains the centers and covers at least 50 percent of each of two or more confirmed visual-face reference envelopes.
matching.duplicate: Additional non-merge candidate matches an already matched reference at IoU >= 0.50.
matching.lower_selection: A confirmed-present candidate offered as a top hypothesis has its center in a labeled lower fragment or covers at least 50 percent of the fragment; report only this conservative proxy, not full layer accuracy.
matching.orientation: Undirected polygon long-axis error modulo 180 degrees on matched individual references. Mark this as substantially supplied/manual registration, not autonomous 6D estimation.
matching.registration: Within matched reference instances, one-to-one nearest projected expected stud positions to the selected manual stud centers. Report all reference errors and coverage separately from image-derived observed peak localization.
matching.stud_peak: If the implementation exposes image-derived stud peak locations, one-to-one matching within 8 px to the 48 selected manual centers; report matched error and missed-reference coverage. No precision claim for unannotated studs.
matching.ambiguity: All 14 original ambiguous regions remain excluded from primary positive recall and spurious classification. Six are additionally measured in the explicitly separate image-plane missing-face track.

decision_reporting.positive_correct: confirmed present on a primary positive reference
decision_reporting.positive_wrong: confirmed missing on a primary positive reference
decision_reporting.positive_uncertain: uncertain or no matched candidate on a primary positive reference
decision_reporting.missing_correct: confirmed missing on a supplementary missing-face slot
decision_reporting.missing_wrong: confirmed present on a supplementary missing-face slot
decision_reporting.coverage: Report the fraction receiving a non-uncertain decision, correct-confirmed fraction, and incorrect-confirmed fraction for each reference track and each split. Missing/no candidate must not silently count as a correct missing decision.
decision_reporting.tradeoff: Always report all decision counts and coverage at the fixed deployed thresholds. Do not select confidence thresholds using held-out labels or report a high reliability obtained by rejecting almost all cells.

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: nominal
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: unchanged image and supplied coarse registration

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: brightness_070
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: multiply all image channels by 0.70 then clip; geometry unchanged

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: brightness_130
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: multiply all image channels by 1.30 then clip; geometry unchanged

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: rotation_m05
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: rotate image -5 degrees about image center with reflected border; transform coarse input, reference polygons and reference studs coherently

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: rotation_p05
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: rotate image +5 degrees about image center with reflected border; transform coarse input, reference polygons and reference studs coherently

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: initial_x_m04
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: shift only supplied coarse registration -4 px in image x; image and scoring references unchanged

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: initial_x_p04
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: shift only supplied coarse registration +4 px in image x; image and scoring references unchanged

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: initial_y_m04
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: shift only supplied coarse registration -4 px in image y; image and scoring references unchanged

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: initial_y_p04
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: shift only supplied coarse registration +4 px in image y; image and scoring references unchanged

fixed_sensitivity_cases.name: flat_image_sanity
fixed_sensitivity_cases.operation: replace RGB with its per-image channel means; retain geometry. No candidate may be confirmed present without image evidence. This is a counterfactual sanity check, not a photographed absence ground truth.

proposed_demonstration_acceptance.interpretation: Conditional known-layout visual-face demonstration criteria, not safe picking, true current-layer correctness, physical occupancy, metric accuracy or independent generalization. Sensitivity regressions must remain explicit and may prevent acceptance even if nominal criteria pass.

leakage_controls: The perception process must not load evaluation references, historical detector outputs or simulator identities/poses/colors/connections.
Only coarse manually assisted global registration, expected repeatable geometry and explicitly supplied layer/plane hypotheses are perception inputs.
No per-instance or per-strip adjustment from reference polygons. Held-out coarse global registration is prepared independently from raw images and remains fixed.
Held-out outputs are disclosed only as aggregate/review evidence after an evaluated implementation is frozen; no image-specific tuning is accepted.
Every batch evaluation and sensitivity run uses the default Pueue queue and immutable code/config/input/reference snapshots.

simulation.rule: No smaller final benchmark or invented origins. A later confirmed simulation must use the exact same perception code; truth is scoring-only.
